newsitem.title: USA: RCSB Financial ends stock buyback.
newsitem.headline: RCSB Financial ends stock buyback.

text.p: RCSB Financial Inc said on Wednesday it has terminated its current share repurchase program due to a pending merger with Charter One Financial Inc.
On October 23, 1996, RCSB's board authorized the repurchase of 1.5 million shares and 947,100 shares under this authorization have been repurchased at an average price of $30.53.
RCSB ceased repurchasing its shares prior to entering into merger discussions in March 1997 with Charter One, a $14 billion thrift, it said.
RCSB's merger into Charter One is expected to be completed in the 1997 fourth quarter pending regulatory and shareholder approvals, it said.

The merger calls for the tax-free exchange of 0.91 shares of Charter One common stock for each RCSB common share in a pooling of interests. At March 31, 1997, RCSB had 14.9 million common shares and share equivalents outstanding.
